item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 31 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 31 #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:00 PM 13 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SurigaoDelNorte(Mainit, TaganaAn, SurigaoCity, SanFrancisco, Malimono, Bacuag, Alegria, Gigaquit), #DavaoOriental(Baganga, Cateel, Boston), #SurigaoDelSur(Lingig, CityOfBislig), #AgusanDelSur(Trento), #DavaoDeOro(Monkayo, Compostela and NewBataan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(Tubod, Placer and Sison) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
